findings.title: Out-of-bounds read
findings.trigger: If segment_size is larger than the allocated size of d_elements, accessing d_elements[mid] can lead to out-of-bounds read.
findings.assumptions: The size of the array pointed to by d_elements is not checked against segment_size.

findings.title: Integer overflow
findings.trigger: If low and high are large enough, the calculation of mid can overflow, leading to incorrect indexing.
findings.assumptions: The values of low and high are not validated to prevent overflow.

findings.title: Use-after-free
findings.trigger: If the memory pointed to by d_found is freed before this line is executed, writing to it can lead to use-after-free.
findings.assumptions: The memory pointed to by d_found is not freed before this line.
